subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview/sample first-run tour be rebased and adopted on top of current main, narrowed into a smaller follow-up, or paused in favor of the newer onboarding baseline?
rationale: The remaining blocker is partly product direction: this PR adds a preview/sample onboarding mode while current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, preserved configured-gateway behavior, OpenClawType typography, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample preview pieces maintainers still want and leave setup/security/routing behavior to the current focused onboarding path.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat current main's onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview tour is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, preserved configured-gateway behavior, OpenClawType typography, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant owns the clearest recent merged mobile onboarding/security work that overlaps this PR's iOS setup and typography surfaces.
